svg.title: One request, start to finish: returning a laptop bought 35 days ago. Step 1, a Slack adapter and a router send it to the returns agent (factors 11 and 10). Step 2, the prompt file and only this order's details go to the model, which fills in a form to look up the order (factors 2, 3, 1 and 4). Step 3, code checks the 30-day rule, finds it is too late and asks a manager (factors 8 and 7). Step 4, the run pauses with everything in one record (factors 6 and 5). Step 5, the manager approves, any copy of the agent resumes, and a failed refund call would go back as a one-line error (factors 12 and 9).
